name: T-6 heavy blaster pistol
description: The T-6 "Thunderer" was a heavy blaster pistol manufactured by BlasTech Industries in response to the creation of the Renegade heavy blaster pistol by the SoroSuub Corporation. The "Thunderer" was created with the sole purpose of surpassing its rivals in pure power, and allowed BlasTech to claim the title "king of the blaster wars".
